summary.value: Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square is a Hilton lifestyle hotel in Midtown: Motto New York City Times Square will entice guests looking for connection and efficiency, with Guest rooms designed with an intentional footprint. It suits budget-minded travelers who plan to be out all day, and Trip.com guests rate it 8.6 / 10 Very good 729 reviews, calling it “Affordable and clean, you get what you pay for in New York” and noting “The front desk staff were also very nice”. The honest trade-off: “Rooms are super small”.

description.value: Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square is a Hilton lifestyle hotel in Midtown. Hilton says Motto will entice guests looking for connection and efficiency. Its guest rooms are designed with an intentional footprint, so expect compact rooms and a central location near Broadway. Trip.com shows 8.6 / 10 Very good 729 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Affordable and clean, you get what you pay for in New York”; “The front desk staff were also very nice”. Representative watch-outs: “Rooms are super small”.
